-- 1. 셀피아 상품 마스터
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pm_products (
    sellpia_code   VARCHAR(20)  PRIMARY KEY,
    product_id     INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    option_seq     INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    product_name   TEXT,
    option_name    TEXT,
    supplier       TEXT,
    created_at     TIMESTAMPTZ  DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pm_products_product_id ON pm_products(product_id);

-- 2. 메이크샵
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pm_makeshop (
    id             SERIAL       PRIMARY KEY,
    sellpia_code   VARCHAR(20)  REFERENCES pm_products(sellpia_code),
    makeshop_code  VARCHAR(50),
    product_name   TEXT,
    option_name    TEXT,
    price          INTEGER,
    option_price   INTEGER
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pm_makeshop_sellpia ON pm_makeshop(sellpia_code);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pm_makeshop_code ON pm_makeshop(makeshop_code);

-- 3. 스마트스토어 (매칭 성공)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pm_smartstore (
    id             SERIAL       PRIMARY KEY,
    sellpia_code   VARCHAR(20)  REFERENCES pm_products(sellpia_code),
    product_no     BIGINT,
    option_no      BIGINT,
    option_code    VARCHAR(50),
    ss_option_name TEXT,
    price          INTEGER,
    discount_price INTEGER
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pm_smartstore_sellpia ON pm_smartstore(sellpia_code);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pm_smartstore_product_no ON pm_smartstore(product_no);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_pm_smartstore_option_code ON pm_smartstore(option_code);

-- 4. 스마트스토어 미매칭
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pm_smartstore_unmatched (
    id             SERIAL       PRIMARY KEY,
    ss_own_code    VARCHAR(20),
    sellpia_code   VARCHAR(20),
    product_no     BIGINT,
    option_no      BIGINT,
    option_code    VARCHAR(50),
    ss_option_name TEXT,
    reason         TEXT,
    created_at     TIMESTAMPTZ  DEFAULT NOW()
);
